description: Compare up to 20 public scans side by side: each with URL, final URL, host, title, AI verdict and risk score, rule-based risk, screenshot URL, and the values that link it to other scans (domains, IP addresses, hashes, technologies, certificate, JARM, registration, CPE and threat-intelligence matches). missing lists IDs that are not public scans. The per-scan searchable-value lists (typically 50 to 150 KB per scan) are left out unless include_pivot_values is true; favicon images are always left out.

include_pivot_values.description: Also include each scan's full list of searchable values (often 50 to 150 KB per scan).
include_pivot_values.title: Include Pivot Values

scan_ids.description: UUIDs of 1 to 20 public scans to compare; duplicates are ignored.
scan_ids.title: Scan Ids
